code: import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}insurance-companies`;const getInsuranceCompaines=async(params,allFlag)=>{let response;if(!allFlag){response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params:{...params,limit:+(params===null||params===void 0?void 0:params.limit)||50}});}else{response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,{params:{...params}});}return response.data;};const deleteInsuranceCompany=async id=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+id);return response.data;};const updateInsuranceCompany=async(id,data)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+id,data);return response.data;};const createInsuranceCompany=async data=>{const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,data);return response.data;};const InsuranceCompanyService={createInsuranceCompany,deleteInsuranceCompany,updateInsuranceCompany,getInsuranceCompaines};export default InsuranceCompanyService;
